readerCopy.body: The choice that keeps everyone comfortable can be the same choice that keeps an important preference out of the plan. When Lilith squares the North Node, autonomy and forward movement create friction with family expectations, relationship agreements, workplace norms, or socially acceptable versions of success. Defiance alone does not build a better arrangement. The tension becomes useful when the unacceptable term is named clearly enough to show what would actually have to change.
